cpmaddpackage(
    NAME tracy
    VERSION 0.15.0
    URL https://codeload.github.com/wolfpld/tracy/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.15.0
    URL_HASH SHA256=3d57da54aa67d7875da1e8fecd0bd5957675cef73c27dd52bffb6ab8d290a5e6
    SYSTEM YES
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL YES
    OPTIONS
        "TRACY_ENABLE ON"
        "TRACY_STATIC OFF"
        "TRACY_ON_DEMAND ON"
        "TRACY_ONLY_LOCALHOST ON"
        "TRACY_ONLY_IPV4 ON"
        "TRACY_NO_BROADCAST ON"
        "TRACY_NO_CODE_TRANSFER ON"
        "TRACY_NO_SYSTEM_TRACING ON"
        "TRACY_NO_CALLSTACK ON"
        "TRACY_NO_FRAME_IMAGE ON"
        "TRACY_NO_CRASH_HANDLER ON"
        "TRACY_TIMER_FALLBACK ON"
)

install(TARGETS TracyClient
    EXPORT PolosTargets
    LIBRARY DESTINATION "${POLOS_INSTALL_LIB_DIR}" COMPONENT Runtime NAMELINK_COMPONENT SDK
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION "${POLOS_INSTALL_LIB_DIR}" COMPONENT SDK
    RUNTIME DESTINATION "${POLOS_INSTALL_LIB_DIR}" COMPONENT Runtime
)
install(DIRECTORY "${tracy_SOURCE_DIR}/public/"
    DESTINATION "${POLOS_INSTALL_INC_DIR}"
    COMPONENT SDK
    FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.h" PATTERN "*.hpp"
)
install(FILES "${tracy_SOURCE_DIR}/LICENSE"
    DESTINATION "${POLOS_INSTALL_DIR}"
    RENAME LICENSE-Tracy.txt
    COMPONENT Runtime
)
install(FILES "${tracy_SOURCE_DIR}/public/libbacktrace/LICENSE"
    DESTINATION "${POLOS_INSTALL_DIR}/licenses/tracy-libbacktrace"
    COMPONENT SDK
)
